name: OpenLTM Memory
description: Long-term memory for OpenClaw agents, stored in a local SQLite database. FTS5 search with optional vector recall, importance-weighted decay, a memory graph, and a shared database with the Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi plugins.

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Inject a compact Prior Knowledge block into the system prompt at the start of each turn

prefillLines.label: Prefill Line Budget
prefillLines.help: Maximum lines in the injected Prior Knowledge block

dbPath.label: Database Path
dbPath.help: Override the shared openltm.db location. Leave blank to use the default.
